armorContract.requestedSpins: The committed armor-count result N requires exactly N actual armor-piece spins.
armorContract.scope: One Dwarf armor-award event, identified by runId, event invocation, and component slot when applicable.
armorContract.beforeEachDraw: Remove all chosen armor IDs from the eligible set, apply declared guards to remaining pieces, normalize remaining weights, and freeze this draw distribution.
armorContract.commit: Atomically journal the result, append the chosen ID, grant its armor instance and one +1 numeric modifier, update remaining IDs, append context, then react.
armorContract.repeatKey: Every scheduled draw has its own stable invocation ID and ordinal; do not share one consumed-event key across repeated draws.
armorContract.duplicatePolicy: Chosen pieces always have effective weight zero. Weight modifiers cannot restore their eligibility. Never reroll a committed duplicate or substitute another result.
armorContract.wheelRendering: Chosen sections are disabled and have zero sector angle in subsequent active wheels. Redistribute the active circle using remaining frozen probabilities; show collected pieces outside the active wheel if desired.
armorContract.lastDrawPolicy: If N=5, the fifth scheduled piece spin still occurs with the sole remaining piece at 100%, then receives its own result/reaction. This is an explicit exception to the generic fixed-identity reveal shortcut.

pieceWeights.status: User-confirmed equal probability default for eligible armor pieces; preserve specified armor-count weights.
pieceWeights.reason: Equal active-piece base odds follow the user default. Remove selected pieces before normalizing; change the base distribution only if the user specifies an override before a draw.

armorContract.poolExhaustion: Configuration error if requested remaining draws exceed eligible remaining unique pieces; do not truncate the awarded count or silently reuse a piece.
armorContract.bonusUnits: Numeric points, following the established +1-point convention; numeric scales or explicit mappings required.
armorContract.additionalStats: No unrequested material, quality, weight, durability, intelligence, or mobility effects are inferred.

gnomeTechContract.poolOrder: Catalog order only; no potency ranking requested.
gnomeTechContract.grant: Grant exactly one technology weapon instance from the selected result.
gnomeTechContract.mastery: Register unresolved Weapon Mastery and process it at the normal main Weapon stage, including when the main draw is None.
gnomeTechContract.existingGear: Keep the tech weapon alongside any later weapons; follow the shared owned-inventory and grant-provenance contract.
gnomeTechContract.powerBoundary: Effects produced by a technology weapon do not automatically grant a matching personal power.
gnomeTechContract.weights: User-confirmed equal base weights (1 per eligible option) unless the user specified a distribution; declared eligibility and conditional modifiers are applied before normalization.
gnomeTechContract.theme: Gnome tinker gadgets based on clockwork, steam, springs, traps, lenses, alchemy, and decoys.
gnomeTechContract.weaponClassification: Direct attacks, traps, control devices, and tactical decoys all count as weapons under the user rule. A construct gadget includes its operating mechanism/controller in one weapon kit; it does not spawn extra weapon or power grants.
gnomeTechContract.masteryMeaning: Precision, timing, targeting, placement, and operation/control of the chosen gadget; actual mastery rank remains a later spin.
gnomeTechContract.sourcePolicy: Official sources support the broad tinkering/clockwork and mechanized-gnome themes. These twenty gadgets and combat functions are original game adaptations, not a list of canonical racial equipment.

sizePhase.meaning: A declared characteristic body dimension: humanoid height, elongated body length, or spherical diameter. Exclude wingspan unless the profile explicitly selects it. Celestial labels compare that linear dimension with the reference diameter.

normal.interpretation: The requested 0.5-to-2 range is subdivided into twelve equal steps/positions. A literal increment of 0.5 would yield only four sections.
normal.coordinate: linear multiplier relative to reference A
normal.parameterStatus: Broad width sigma=0.5 is a proposed tuning default; normal shape and broad width are requested.
normal.normalization: Discrete Gaussian-derived weights at the twelve support points; this is a bounded discrete wheel, not an unbounded continuous normal draw.
normal.expectedValueNote: The asymmetric support [0.5,2] means the resulting discrete expected multiplier is not exactly 1, even though the Gaussian center is 1.

giant.coordinate: User-named milestones across orders of magnitude; magnitude spacing does not assign odds
giant.parameterStatus: User-confirmed equal probability default; previous assistant-proposed log-Gaussian odds retired.

sizePhase.profileResolution: Declared selected form/reference profile -> explicit generic species profile -> explicitly declared composition/host-size rule. Giant override wins when activated. Missing references are configuration gaps, never silent Human averages.
sizePhase.averageAuthority: Record the selected source and version. A stated mean may be used directly; a midpoint/rounded anchor from a lore range is a labeled game estimate, not a measured population mean.
sizePhase.baselineFreeze: Freeze profile, reference value, metric, multipliers/giant variant, source version, and exact odds before the Size draw. Later effects do not alter a committed Size result.
sizePhase.stats: Size is stored separately from base stats. It can declare later stat odds, equipment compatibility, and weakness effects; no automatic flat stat increase, unlimited mass scaling, or canonical power package.
sizePhase.lateChange: An explicitly approved later size change records its own effect/context and checks the same cosmic threshold without rerolling earlier Size or stat results.

raceNoRepeat.status: User-confirmed global no-repeat history, including every nested family in the first Hybrid chain before its second draw.
raceNoRepeat.scope: Every character-identity race draw: main, Hybrid roots, Symbiote host, Raksasa base, Skeleton/Zombie origin, Mutant mutation root and every nested mutation identity draw.
raceNoRepeat.key: Canonical selectionFamilyId / option.familyId; enforce at the level selected by the race-family wheel.
raceNoRepeat.state: raceSelectionHistory[] and usedRaceFamilyIds[] shared by the whole character across all origin/parent branches.
raceNoRepeat.initial: The first main race result is committed to history before its subtype or other race events run. Selecting Skeleton/Zombie therefore already marks Lelembut used.
raceNoRepeat.beforeDraw: Intersect existing caller eligibility with familyId not in usedRaceFamilyIds. Disable all used sections before drawing; do not sample them then reroll.
raceNoRepeat.weights: Use user-specified weights where present, otherwise base weight 1. Apply approved modifiers and normalize over eligible positive weights. All previously selected race families have probability zero; exclusion dominates modifiers.
raceNoRepeat.commit: Atomically append invocation/role/family/component provenance and add the selected family to usedRaceFamilyIds before dispatching any child race events. Nested descendants use the same character history, never a copied/reset per-component set.
raceNoRepeat.resume: A resumed committed invocation reuses its result. It does not apply the exclusion to itself and reroll; history and consumed-event keys restore atomically.
raceNoRepeat.bounded: Each new identity-family result strictly enlarges the used set. At most the number of unique eligible catalog families can commit (19 in the current main pool), so race-family cycles cannot repeat indefinitely.
raceNoRepeat.emptyPool: A required draw with no eligible positive-weight candidate is an explicit configuration error. Never reset history, restore used sections, silently skip, or reroll a committed result.
raceNoRepeat.subtypes: Selecting a subtype/form is resolving the already-selected family, not selecting that family again. Known lore ancestry is not added to history unless it was actually selected by an identity race wheel.
raceNoRepeat.referenceBoundary: Vampire prey is a reference to a target, not a character race acquisition; it keeps its existing separate reference contract and does not consume personal race history.
raceNoRepeat.archetypeBoundary: Initial eligibility is evaluated once after the complete initial Race tree. Mutant may subsequently acquire a new race during its Archetype event using the same global history. Preserve the frozen pre-mutation gate/result; mutation children restore the saved Mutant caller and never re-enter the gate. Initial Raksasa skips; mutation-acquired Raksasa keeps giant Size but does not revoke the selected Mutant. Older committed journals retain their original policy.
raceNoRepeat.example: Hybrid → Symbiote → Raksasa → Abyssal Axiom commits hybrid/symbiote/raksasa/demon. The second Hybrid draw excludes all four (plus any earlier history), leaving 15 of 19 if all other options are eligible.

Nanobot directly Shapeshifting; AI directly Digital Being/+2 Intelligence, Cyborg one weapon/+1 Intelligence, Android one power. one actual machine-type spin/reaction once its roster is approved

machineEvents.size: One global Size stage; Machine body reference/metric and subtype measurements remain pending. Never default to Human or add a second Size spin. Existing Raksasa giant binding still applies when actually selected.
machineEvents.effects: AI grants Digital Being plus +2 numeric Intelligence once per type source, no additional AI type spin. Cyborg +1 numeric Intelligence once plus exactly one weapon; Android exactly one owned power. Mecha only chosen body-model identity. Transformer selects one vehicle form and receives its linked Vehicle Shifting power, without another power selector. Nanobot directly grants one Shapeshifting power, without subtype/model/acquisition spin. Household now grants one extremely weak mundane-function power linked to its actual item, with no additional acquisition spin.
machineEvents.mastery: Any later approved powers use the one common Power Mastery, with existing source-scoped exceptions. Weapons retain per-weapon mastery/compatible Master+ Enchant; Machine alone adds no mastery modifier.
machineEvents.context: Stack only actual family/type/event commits and their provenance. Narration does not generate effects or future stat/type facts.
machineEvents.influence: Future conditional probability/eligibility profiles remain pending. Type identity alone does not invent multipliers, restrictions or guaranteed stats.
machineEvents.idempotence: One subtype invocation per actual Machine source component, linked to parent spin/component/root slot and exact continuation. Resume restores actual committed results without new draws or duplicated effects.

vehicleShifting.scope: Only the actual selected vehicle form; no separate owned vehicle, crew, built-in weapons, stat bonuses, automatic Flight power, extra Size or unlimited forms.
